operation_proposals.source_operation: Structured omics-row prompt construction with tagged metadata, directional gene lists, differential methylation/protein representations, and leading experimental-design instructions.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog already represents ordered text construction and subsequent tokenization separately; unsupported source-specific reductions remain opaque boundaries.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Three-layer modality mapper that maps biomedical-text or knowledge-graph embeddings into the language-model latent space.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: project represents the documented feed-forward mapping. The paper does not establish the later fusion algebra or insertion position.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Averaging P3GPT or GenePT embeddings across selected gene lists and methylation-selected genes.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no averaging or pooling primitive, so the documented averaging remains an unexpanded boundary.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Stacking P3GPT embeddings with selected promoter beta-value features before CatBoost.
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: concatenate represents the documented human-clock feature join. The panmammalian source establishes stacked embeddings but does not establish beta-value concatenation in the final predictor input.
